_comment: Jores 2026 plant multi-condition MPRA, AlphaGenome encoder + MPRAHead(num_outputs=5). Two-stage: head-only then encoder unfrozen. Hyperparameters from the released model (HPO-selected). Uses the standard alphagenome_encoder_ft (Nagai) config schema; the jores split/adapters are handled by alphagenome_ft_mpra.jores_multicondition_data, not this config. Set input_tsv/pretrained_weights via CLI.
